claim: The combiner's four lines are blanked on DAQ Dev1 port 0 as 405 nm on line2, 488 on line4, 561 on line6 and 640 on line8, with DAC indices 0 to 3 in the same order. Blanking is active-high: writing 1 opens a line and 0 closes it.
validity_conditions: Ruled TRANSFER, passed 10.3 rules 1 and 3: the map and polarity are machine-readable constants in the prior project's probe script, and that project's record says the map was read off the vendor program's live configuration dialog on 2026-09-02, which outranked three device-database copies of which two put 405 on line1. Polarity was measured by eye that day, on 561 and 640. Slot: a contract field -- the device table's line_select element (lines, open_level, closed_level), which the confocal wrapper reads and refuses without; filling that element is a table edit and goes with the seat that publishes. THIS DECIDES WHICH LASER A COMMAND OPENS, so it is E3 about wiring nothing here has confirmed: confirm each line at the bench, by eye, before a plan relies on it, and that confirmation supersedes this entry. Falsified by any line emitting a different wavelength than mapped, or a line opening on 0. Rewiring the DAQ falsifies it silently. Delivered as item `combiner_line_map_and_polarity` of microscope_agent/findings/microscope-20260924-3-20260924.json at a5e7647 (card 044); the source was opened at fbedef0 and its sha256 matched before this was ruled.
